findings.question: track_adapter._evaluate_in_process / A4 drifted-build test
findings.evidence: Extracting MetalKernelPipelineEvaluator into kernel_pipeline.py removed _evaluate_in_process from track_adapter.py and called kernel_pipeline._evaluate_in_process directly, breaking test_a4_real_evaluator_refuses_a_drifted_full_build (test_track_a4.py:1382,1393).
findings.resolution: Re-exported _evaluate_in_process in track_adapter.py, added _run_in_process hook on MetalKernelPipelineEvaluator, overrode _run_in_process on MetalTrackEvaluator to call track_adapter._evaluate_in_process, and added CPU regression test in test_tilelang_mt4.py.

findings.question: Vector reflection (v2_runtime vs stage_binding)
findings.evidence: stage_binding.py:45 supports VECTOR_WIDTHS=(1,2,4,8), while v2_runtime.py:651-665 (_msl_scalar_type) has only mapped scalar MTLDataType codes since A4. TileLang emits scalar pointer parameters in kernel signatures and does not hit this path.
findings.resolution: Documented as pre-existing A4 limitation; no runtime expansion in MT4.

findings.question: Kernel name (_same_kernel vs Metal builder)
findings.evidence: tcenv/track/tilelang.py:835 (_same_kernel) is part of the frozen MT1b /1 source-only contract. In /2, taic/prompts.py:71-72,253 explicitly requires emitted Metal symbols (e.g. relu_kernel_kernel) in host/execution_geometry.json; an un-suffixed name is cleanly rejected by MetalSourceBuilder as a schema-4 compile_error (partial build).
findings.resolution: Kept /1 frozen contract and /2 prompt + compile_error rejection unchanged.

findings.question: Prompt wording (prompt-epoch.json candidate_generation_executed=false)
findings.evidence: prompt-epoch.json records the CPU-only prompt fingerprint snapshot (modeled after MT1a/after.json), where computing the snapshot itself did not execute model generation; the real DeepSeek Flash generation is recorded in identity.json (candidate_model_calls=1) and evidence/deepseek-relu-r1/.
findings.resolution: Kept sealed prompt-epoch.json and manifest.sha256 intact; documented scope semantics in RESULT.md.

findings.question: Self-check environment (nested Seatbelt vs production bounded evaluation)
findings.evidence: Inside an agent's hmz Seatbelt session, running HmzFenceExecutor triggers nested sandbox-exec which macOS denies. Production evaluation runs from the host Orchestrator -> V2LocalEvaluator -> run_bounded_v2 without nested Seatbelt and succeeded (report.json + replay.json).
findings.resolution: Documented boundary between in-session nested sandbox limitation and host production bounded evaluation evidence.

findings.question: Full suite environment differences
findings.evidence: full-suite-r2.json (4963 passed / 26 failed / 13 skipped) matches MT1b/p2-epoch-drift.json exactly; transient parallel worker failures in other runs come from macOS AF_UNIX path length or sandbox limits and pass with -n 0.
findings.resolution: Preserved all tests and assertions without skip/xfail.

findings.question: Reviewer history
findings.evidence: Two prior attempts (one stopped via /flow stop, one unstarted due to unavailable model slug) produced no review signature; done and reviewer_done remain false.
findings.resolution: Left done=false and reviewer_done=false for independent Reviewer sign-off.
